_about: Design tokens for the clean-room clone (Module B = Veredicta reference, Module A = WhatsApp, no reference). replica-design filled these from recon evidence + pixel measurements of the 3 reference screenshots in replica/screens/; replica-brand swaps VALUES only, role names stay. Check every change with: py C:\Users\Usuario\.config\opencode\skills\replica-design\contrast.py tokens.json

_provenance.measured: Colour roles sampled with PIL from asistente-expediente-v1.webp (2880x1800 full app screen), asistente-panel-v1.webp (800x1040 assistant panel) and finanzas.webp (1920x1080 marketing shot with real app UI). Dominant colours per region, e.g. text #262626, muted #686868, canvas #f6f6f6-#f8f8f8, sidebar #f9f9f9, cards #ffffff.
_provenance.from_recon: Incidental colours documented in recon.md evidence gaps #1: yellow favorite star, blue unread dot, red overdue, green success, 11 agenda category colours (Google-Calendar-like).
_provenance.derived: Grey ladder and any tint not present in a screenshot follow a standard SaaS grey ladder (5-7 steps). Values that inputs cannot decide are marked TODO(gap): unmeasured.
deviations: border-input: product measures #e5e5e5 (fails WCAG 3:1 on white); clone raises it to #868686 to clear the AA floor.
tertiary text: product measures #868686 (3.6:1, fails AA for body); clone folds it into text-muted #686868 (5.6:1).
danger: product mixes #fb2c36 (badge, 3.8:1 with white text, fails AA) and ~#ae342b (overdue text core); clone uses the measured dark core #ae342b for all danger text/fills.
success dot #00bc7d measures 2.5:1 on white; clone uses the measured text green #007949 (5.5:1) for dots too.
body text is 14px in the product's tables; the low-technical-resistance constraint raises body to 16px (type.base).

color._placeholder: accent is a PLACEHOLDER neutral-ish brand colour (muted slate-indigo, deliberately NOT Veredicta's measured indigo #4f39f6/#432dd7). replica-brand replaces the value with our own palette; role names stay.

_notes.bg: measured: canvas between cards #f6f6f6/#f7f7f7/#f8f8f8, sidebar #f9f9f9 (kept as the same step, delta is imperceptible)
_notes.surface: measured: cards, table rows, assistant panel, active nav pill #ffffff
_notes.border: measured: card edges and dividers #e5e5e5 / #ededed / #dedede (decorative only, not WCAG-checked)
_notes.border-input: measured product value #e5e5e5 raised to #868686 for the 3:1 UI floor (see _provenance.deviations)
_notes.accent: PLACEHOLDER - not measured, not Veredicta's brand colour; replica-brand swaps it
_notes.danger: measured: core of the red overdue text ~#ae342b; badge red #fb2c36 rejected (3.8:1 with white text)
_notes.success-tint: measured #e5f8f1 (tint around the green status dot)
_notes.info: measured: blue link/indicator #1447e6 (also #1975d1 PJN chip); serves the recon's 'blue unread dot'
_notes.accent-tint: TODO(gap): unmeasured - light step derived for the placeholder accent; replica-brand must recompute it with the new accent
_notes.favorite: measured #fba503 (favorite star); excluded from 'pairs' because it is a decorative icon whose state is also exposed via fill shape + aria-pressed + tooltip, and it measures 2.0:1 on white

font._category: sans / neo-grotesque - Inter (SIL Open Font License, open font only; the product's font is proprietary and is NOT copied)
font._icons: Lucide (MIT) as the icon set; no Veredicta logos, icons or illustrations are reused
font.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

type._note: Snapped scale 12/14/16/20/28/40. Body minimum is 16px (low-technical-resistance constraint); xs/sm are for counters, chips and meta only.

shadow._note: flat system: cards are border-led (measured hairline #e5e5e5), shadows only for overlays

layout._note: sidebar 240px per recon; assistant side panel 400px and >=1024px only (S23); mobile <768px swaps the sidebar for a bottom bar (S38).

breakpoints._mobile: below md (768px) = bottom bar + Menú screen; assistant panel only at lg (1024px) and up
